prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a rear-end collision. The patient had 30 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1439; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with a wrist fracture consistent in kind and mechanism with the force of the impact. Over the course of 30 office visits, care proceeded along a typical trajectory: immobilization, serial radiographic follow-up, supervised progressive range-of-motion work, and graduated strengthening. Visit frequency decreased steadily as function returned and pain diminished. On examination, localized tenderness and reduced grip strength over the affected wrist correlate with the documented fracture, while several neurovascular and stability tests returned within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury to this area, and no earlier treatment records for the wrist were identified. Billing for the episode reflects single, non-duplicated charges for each service rendered. At last review, the patient had regained most functional motion and was discharged to home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
